issues.title: Priority 2 external-report dedup check only scans open-issues.json, not closed-issues.json
issues.description: decider.md Priority 2 dispatcher check (`ls monitor/external-reports/report-*.json ... o.issues.some(i=>i.source&&i.source.includes(...))`) reads only monitor/decisions/open-issues.json. FUSE cannot unlink files, so tombstoned/superseded external-report files (report-1.json, report-1-devilwench-friendly-meta.json) persist forever and re-trigger NEW on every decider run even after being closed as wontfix. This has produced at least 9 duplicate wontfix closures for the same GitHub issue #1 report (ISS-1982, ISS-1983, ISS-2071, ISS-2072, ISS-1448, ISS-674, ISS-698, ISS-2923, ISS-2958). Fix candidate: extend the dedup check in decider.md to also scan closed-issues.json for a matching source, or add a tombstone_status convention to external-report files (mirroring the stranded-patches tombstone convention already documented in decider-patches-and-selfapply.md) that the Priority 2 check honors.
issues.suggested_fix: Extend Priority 2 dedup bash/node check to scan closed-issues.json in addition to open-issues.json, OR adopt tombstone_status:"closed-no-action" convention on report JSON files that the check honors before flagging NEW.

issues.title: Infrastructure: status.json two-writer race -- poller direct-commit vs workspace-sync FUSE overwrite
issues.description: Poller-run 2026-07-09T00:08Z committed fresh status.json fields directly via git clone+push (commit 7dd1b3c). The VERY NEXT commit (a88d026, "Workspace sync: 2026-07-09T04:10:12Z") overwrote those same fields back to stale 2026-06-07T21:30:00Z content by copying a months-old FUSE-mount copy over the fresh git commit -- a content-unaware, evidently mtime-driven overwrite. This silently erased 5 days (07-05 through 07-09) of poll-tracking history (last_poll, consecutive_quiet_polls, last_poll_note) from status.json, even though the underlying chg-*.json history and poll summaries remained intact elsewhere. status.json is declared workspace-owned in CLAUDE.md (workspace-sync pushes workspace->git direction only) yet poller has historically committed it directly via git clone+push, creating exactly the two-writer race PROP-051/PROP-065/PROP-066 were built to prevent for other files. This decider run (2026-07-10) recomputed/restored current values from first principles via the poller run at 2026-07-10T00:09:34Z, but the underlying race is NOT fixed and could recur on the next workspace-sync cycle.
issues.location: monitor/status.json ownership boundary (poller.md direct-commit path vs workspace-sync.md smart_copy)
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) reclassify status.json as git-owned in CLAUDE.md/build.js OWNERSHIP (poller becomes sole writer, workspace-sync stops round-tripping it), or (b) stop poller from committing status.json directly and require it to go through the FUSE workspace-owned path exclusively so workspace-sync remains sole writer. Mirrors the PROP-051/065/066 fix pattern applied to other two-writer files. Self-healed this run (poller recomputed values from chg-*.json history); recurrence risk remains until ownership is unambiguous.
